page: Microsoft Azure NC16ads_A10_v4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine powered by an AMD x86_64 processor under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 200.0 GB of system memory, providing a generous allocation of 12.5 GB RAM per core. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single integrated NVIDIA A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of dedicated video memory, accommodating graphics pipelines, rendering, and deep learning inference.

Local ephemeral storage is provisioned via a 1546 GB solid-state drive (SSD), providing substantial local disk capacity for caching models, scratch data, and intermediate training outputs. Additionally, the instance supports Premium Storage configurations for external managed disks. Networking configurations omit complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating virtual networks, private routing, or explicitly allocated IP addresses for external connectivity.

With a balance of dedicated compute, high system memory density, substantial fast local storage, and single-GPU acceleration, the instance provides cost-efficient resource provisioning for workloads that require workstation-class graphical processing or mid-tier AI inference without the overhead of enterprise multi-GPU clusters. Tradeoffs include reliance on a single accelerator device and absence of bundled public networking.

Microsoft Azure NC16ads_A10_v4 is suited for AI and machine learning inference, graphics-intensive workstation tasks, video processing, computer vision pipelines, and data processing workflows requiring high system memory coupled with GPU acceleration.
